review.notes: Structure and droppage pass over all 38 physical pages: code fences balanced; fragment-level PDF-text diff found zero dropped prose, table bodies, prompt-box chunks or reference entries (only figure-caption numbering noise on p.14, whose captions are present); numeric multiset comparison clean (residual PDF-side numbers are page-footer numbers and figure-internal text). Repairs: two OCR ## promotions that inverted the heading hierarchy against their numbered parents (5.1.2.4, 6.3.1) plus one dropped sub-heading restored (Apollo Research), one table callout label demoted to bold text, three mid-sentence paragraph splits at page joins rejoined, and the not\_unsafe Markdown escape normalized to the printed underscore. Contents listing, prompt transcripts and footnote superscripts are intact. Minor items left unchanged: the footnote 2 body sits between two Cyber Range bullets instead of at the page bottom (ordering artifact, text intact), and one paragraph glued to the Table 12 caption line.
